Tender Notice - 17
Tuesday, 03 January 2017
6764 Hits
The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items. The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “The Dean, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by 19/01/2017 up to 3.00 PM. The Technical Bids will be open on the next day i.e. 20/01/2017 at 3.00 pm in the Committee Room, Dean Office. The tender fees of Rs. 1,000/- (nonrefundable) is to be paid by Cash or by enclosing D.D. favoring ‘Kasturba Health Society, Sevagram’ payable at Sevagram / Wardha.
Tender forms will be available in the office of the Dean (Central Purchase Section) on working days between 10.00 am and 4.00 pm. Tender forms also can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Dean reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
A) Radiology Department:
1) CT Scan Machine (64 Slice), 2) 800mA X-Ray Machine with IITV, 3) 600mA X-Ray Machine (Stationary), 4) 100mA X-Ray Machine (Portable), 5) Upgradation of 300mA X-Ray Machine into 600mA X-Ray Machine
B) Surgery Department (2nd Call):
1) Ultrasonic Tissue Dissection Device, 2) Laparoscopic Surgery Instruments
C) Medicine Department:
1) Chairs for Hemodialysis - 5 Nos.
D) Biochemistry Department:
1) Chairs for Blood Collection - 4 Nos.
